description: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky (2009 Chunsoft, Nintendo DS, via RetroArch / melonDS)
long: The expanded, definitive cut of the Explorers duology. You wake up as a human turned Pokemon with no memory, team up with a partner and run Wigglytuff's Guild, then descend into procedurally generated mystery dungeons where every step you take is a turn the whole floor takes with you. Sky adds five playable Special Episodes told from other characters' viewpoints, new dungeons and items, a much larger pool of starters and partners, and keeps the long, unusually sombre story that made the original a cult favourite.
name: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky
short: Turn-based roguelike in which you wake up as a Pokemon: recruit a team, delve procedurally generated dungeons and follow the series' most-loved story, expanded here with five Special Episodes.
